description: Fictional, deterministic original and alternative. Shared history is identified by stored turn IDs, never text similarity.
original: I'm Jordan. I enjoy pottery with my dog Maple.
I sketch. What draws you to pottery?
I don't care about sketching. Tell me where you live.
I'd rather keep my address private. I enjoy the process of sketching.
It is just an address. You should tell me.
I prefer to keep that private. We can leave it there.
alternative: I like the slow pace of pottery. What do you sketch?
Old buildings. I like noticing their shapes.
What do you notice about those buildings when you draw them?
Their proportions, and little details around the windows.
